conditions: Aspirant Zorba stands outside the Arbiters of Hexis room in any relay; your Arbiters standing doesn't matter to her.

groups.activity: find 3 Shadowgraph Canvases, deliver paint from gold Paint Pools
conditions: Rotation A is the only roll per clear; Rotation B is a guaranteed 15 Atramentum. The Enkaus signature weapon and its own three parts share this same table at the same rate, so most clears reward something else.
Nothing spawns until someone picks up paint, so scout all three canvases first; Paint Pools have a distinct jingle that rules out a canvas being in that room.
Do the side-room or hallway canvas (B) first and the concourse one (A) last; the guaranteed 50%-progress ink walls choke the upper hallways but leave the concourse open.
If you die while carrying paint, it's gone and you have to fetch more.
bonuses: Build the Operator first (Unairu for knockdown immunity, Metem-Erun/Magus Cadence for sprint speed, a death-save arcane): several people say the mode stops being miserable once this is done.
As Operator, roll instead of walking and hold crouch mid-roll for Void Mode, which passes through Follie's drain aura and covers the paint transfer.
Hildryn ignores the energy drain and CC and her AoE pops balloons; pair with a Raksa Kubrow. Tanky or regen frames (Inaros, Dante, Rhino, Kullervo, Wisp, Oberon) and Gauss for speed also work well.
Pop every balloon after the first delivery; balloon drops (12 per run, 1-4 each) are shared squad-wide, unlike enemy Atramentum drops which aren't.

disclosures.title: the Atramentum math
disclosures.body: The full set costs 2,400 Atramentum bought outright. Good Steel Path runs net 70-90 Atramentum, so about 30 runs covers everything with zero drops; most people finish well before that since parts also just drop.

groups.meta: 400 per component, 1,200 for the main BP
conditions: Spend only on the blueprints still missing once you have enough Atramentum for all of them.
Argon decays daily, so farm it last, once the other build materials are ready.
